movie.title: Star Trek: First Contact
movie.overview: The Borg, a relentless race of cyborgs, are on a direct course for Earth. Violating orders to stay away from the battle, Captain Picard and the crew of the newly-commissioned USS Enterprise E pursue the Borg back in time to prevent the invaders from changing Federation history and assimilating the galaxy.

facts: Did you know that Jonathan Frakes, who plays Riker, actually directed 'First Contact'? This movie was his very first time directing a feature film!
While it features the beloved TNG crew, 'First Contact' was actually only their second big-screen adventure!
Did you realize the USS Enterprise-E was a brand new ship when the events of 'First Contact' unfolded? It was only newly-commissioned when it jumped into action!
